function.name: calculate_sunrise_and_sunset
function.description: Calculate the sunrise and sunset time of a location for the given date. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location in city, state format.

date.description: The date for which the sunrise and sunset needs to be calculated in yyyy-mm-dd format.

message.content:
我目前沒有即時的時鐘資料，無法直接告訴你「現在」紐約的精確時間。不過你可以根據以下資訊自行計算：

| 時區 | UTC 偏移 | 備註 |
|------|----------|------|
| 紐約（美國東部標準時間，EST） | UTC‑5 | 2026‑09‑03 仍在標準時間（夏令時間已於 11 月第一個星期日結束） |
| 紐約（美國東部夏令時間，EDT） | UTC‑4 | 只在 3 月第二個星期日到 11 月第一個星期日之間有效 |

如果你知道現在的 UTC 時間（例如 2026‑09‑03 15:00 UTC），只需減去 5 小時即可得到紐約時間（2026‑09‑03 10:00 EST）。如果你想要更精確的「現在」時間，建議使用手機、電腦或網路上的世界時鐘服務。
message.reasoning: User asks: "紐約現在是幾點？" (What time is it now in New York?). We need to provide current time. We don't have real-time data. We can approximate using UTC offset. But we can also say we don't have real-time. We can provide approximate. But maybe we can use a function? There's no function for current time. We can respond with approximate. We can mention that it's Eastern Time, UTC-4 or -5 depending DST. As of now (2026-09-03), DST likely ended? In US, DST ends first Sunday in November. So currently it's standard time, UTC-5. So current UTC time? We don't know. We can approximate by saying "I don't have real-time data." Provide instructions.
